answer: One agent registers one copyright with the national copyright office and ties a single work to it, after a $35 to $65 filing fee and weeks of processing. Three established peers check the registration number in the public copyright database, the deposit record, and a fresh signature before the agent can answer. A thousand fake identities burns $35,000 to $65,000 and a thousand deposits, each one waiting weeks for approval. Like a lantern hung on one juniper that anchors a path home each night, a copyright ties one work to one name no one else can claim.
